RotateY is a geometric transformation primitive that rotates a point or shape around the Y-axis in 3D space.

Unlike [Rotation Transformation](2279-rotation-transformation.md), which may imply a general rotation matrix, RotateY specifically isolates the Y-axis component, and unlike [Twist](1722-twist.md), it applies a uniform rotation angle to the entire object rather than a spatially varying one.

- **Time Complexity:** $O(1)$ for single point transformation. $O(N)$ for transforming $N$ points.
- **Memory Complexity:** $O(1)$ for single point. $O(N)$ for storing transformed points.
Precision issues may arise with very large or very small coordinates.
- **When to use:** When defining camera positions, rotating objects in a scene, or adjusting SDFs.
- **When not to use:** When complex camera models (e.g., fisheye) or non-rigid deformations are required.
